records.title: AES-256-CBC VISIONBAK1 backup reader
records.disposition: ADR-040 promises old encrypted backups remain readable; current code auto-detects VISIONBAK1 and VISIONBAK2.
records.readers: Encrypted backup restore path.
records.writers: New backups write authenticated VISIONBAK2 only.
records.persistedData: Existing user backup archives.
records.supportWindow: Indefinite under current ADR; retirement would require a converter and retained recovery utility.
records.liveEvidence: Fixed-byte compatibility fixtures exercise the reader.

records.title: Vision 1.0.2 backup compatibility fixture

records.title: Superseded ADRs and manual rollback contracts
records.disposition: Append-only decisions and recovery artifacts are historical evidence, not runtime debris.
records.readers: Operators, maintainers, incident response, and migration tests.
records.writers: ADRs are append-only; manual contracts execute only under their explicit gates.
records.persistedData: Some manual scripts are the only documented rollback or destructive-maintenance boundary.
records.supportWindow: Retain as project history and operational evidence.
records.replacement: Superseding ADRs describe current decisions without erasing history.
records.liveEvidence: Repository rules explicitly require ADR history and gated rollback artifacts to remain.
